caption: The drawing depicts an ornate object resembling a candelabrum or decorative stand placed centrally on a plain, off-white background. The base is a golden-brown, rounded structure resembling a barrel or urn, sitting on a broad, square platform with cut corners standing on four short feet. Rising from the base is a metallic stem from which several curved branches emerge, each adorned with brown, star-shaped flowers and small leaves. Near the tips of five of the upper branches, there are candle-like elements colored in light grayish hues. The metallic branches, leaves, and flowers are rendered in brownish and gold tones. The composition is symmetrical, and the object is vertically oriented, extending upward in a triangular, tree-like shape. There are no additional objects or background elements in the drawing.
title: Candelabrum
